summary: Valley National Bancorp filed an 8-K announcing an Agreement and Plan of Merger with Providence Financial Corporation, under which Providence will merge into Valley, with Valley as survivor. Providence Bank & Trust (wholly-owned subsidiary) will then merge into Valley National Bank. The transaction is valued via Valley common stock issuance; specific price-per-share, premium, and implied value were not stated in the excerpt. A joint press release and investor presentation were attached as exhibits. Valley will file an S-4 registration statement containing a prospectus and Providence proxy statement. Regulatory approvals and shareholder votes are required; the timing of close and any break fee were not disclosed. Watch for deal terms in the S-4 and regulatory clearances.
